description: This file contains a RecyclerView Adapter for displaying vehicle information in an Android app. It defines the VehicleAdapter class responsible for managing and binding vehicle data to views, as well as an internal ViewHolder class for holding references to item views.
external_methods: View.inflate(int layoutId, ViewGroup parent, boolean attachToRoot)

classes.name: VehicleAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass for binding vehicle data to list item views.

methods.name: VehicleAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a list of vehicle data.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new VehicleHolder object for each item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from vehicleList to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in vehicleList.
